title: Butler hears Thomas play and buys a bass
summary: Butler says Thomas came to Algiers around 1915; he listened under Thomas's house and bought a bass for six dollars down.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

I start with Thomas. When Thomas come here. I didn't go get him. He came here to me. And he came here around in 19 and. Around in 15. And that's when you started. Around in the 1915. September storm. Right about a year after that. I can't remember. Because when this cat come through here with that. I had a little brother. And he used to beat on a tube. You know. And this cat here used to be.
